## Delivered behavior and interfaces

Migration031,64tables/724columns/88public functions. Added RLS-enabled append-only request_triage_events with scoped revision FKs; no raw public/anonymous/authenticated/service-role access. list_review_inbox shares one independently authorized metadata predicate for rows, filtered totals, lane counts and review overview actions. Associates see current exact-stage assigned cases only; a lost/revoked generation disappears. Independent scoped service heads see minimal service/tracking/owner/stage/date metadata for triage, not private submitted titles/body/files by default. No broad work grants or origin access were added. All/unassigned/assigned/aging/revision filters,20-row pages and configured reminder aging are server-derived. Drafts/cancelled/completed cases are absent from the active queue.

read_request_workflow wraps the P22 read to add current permissible actions, stage/outcome/slot metadata, current eligible independent reviewer choices, original/current requested and accepted service dates, canonical evidence manifest ID and latest100 shared triage events. Package access remains requester/current assigned reviewer only, independently authorized per read and file download. Historical participants receive no private triage contents without current entitlement. Published named reviewer defaults or explicit same-size replacements use P22 activation, never a label-based authority shortcut. Revoked authority pauses and can be replaced by a current independent scoped service head.

triage_request derives actor from session, locks current work/revision and effective role/deployment rows, repeats current independence, expected revision/work version and exact actor/key/payload retry. Current assigned reviewers may append shared operational notes; only independent scoped service heads can commit an accepted service date or record general completion. Notes are bounded2000characters, immutable and separate from generic audit/outbox/receipts. Dates retain original/current requested dates, append a reasoned event and do not imply FIN/MCD or external approval. Completion requires exact current revision general_approved outcome, approved instance/state and installed general hooks; protected FIN/MCD/finance-bearing forms fail closed. All business/event/audit/idempotency/outbox effects are atomic. No synthetic approval vote is fabricated for operational completion.

Routes /reviews and /reviews/:term/:request expose the queue and permitted package/actions; existing /department navigation opens the queue. Catalog/Overview/request-tracking links and authenticated review return paths are wired. Native required reason, exact-revision acknowledgement, exact-manifest external evidence, permitted approve/reject/revision/configured-complete and explicit general completion controls use server commands. Configured rejection/revision/completion labels state their actual outcome. Shared note copy names its audience and warns against sensitive contents. Accepted service dates are explicit; Overview shows requested and accepted separately and computes overdue only from an accepted service date. Missing dates never become accepted commitments.

Identity-bound ReviewMemory retains safe reason/reviewer/date/evidence inputs and exact uncertain command payload/key through routine scope remount and refresh; sign-out/identity change clears the memory map. No raw private browser persistence, automatic retry or optimistic approval. Conflict/validation errors preserve inputs; current read replaces stale scope after actions/focus. Lost successful response locks inputs and offers only identical command recovery. Each selected file uses the P22 virtual exact-revision context and existing P12/P17 Edge byte reauthorization; no arbitrary parent links or mutable URL substitution.

## Review and design

Skill-router sequenced writing-plans, Ponytail and existing Impeccable design authority, SQL boundary review and webapp-testing. One assistant simulated product/security/skeptical perspectives, not independent agents. Broad service grants were rejected because they expose private case contents; narrowly authorized metadata plus exact reviewer packages is sufficient. Assigned notes are explicitly shared, while accepted dates/completion remain independent head commitments. Proposed dates cannot silently become agreed dates or overdue commitments. Real institutional authority and human privacy decisions remain gates. Existing Karla/neutral/red tokens, named panels,44px native controls, visible focus and mobile wrapping retained; no redesign or dependency added.
